description: This file implements a web server with various handlers for testing web platform features, including WebSocket support, route management, server process control, and configuration loading.

classes.name: WorkersHandler
classes.description: Handles requests for worker HTML files, serving the appropriate JavaScript and metadata.

classes.name: AnyHtmlHandler
classes.description: Serves HTML pages for tests with embedded scripts, setting global variables for test environment.

classes.name: AnyWorkerHandler
classes.description: Serves worker JavaScript files, importing test scripts and setting global variables.

classes.name: RoutesBuilder
classes.description: Builds and manages server route configurations, including static routes and mount points.

classes.name: ServerProc
classes.description: Manages server process lifecycle, including starting, stopping, and checking if alive.

classes.name: WebSocketDaemon
classes.description: Manages WebSocket server instances, including SSL configuration and server control.

methods.name: replace_end
methods.description: Replaces the ending substring of a string if it matches the specified old string.

methods.name: build_routes
methods.description: Constructs server route configurations based on provided URL-path and directory aliases.

methods.name: setup_logger
methods.description: Initializes logging configuration for the application.

methods.name: open_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket on the specified port.

methods.name: get_port
methods.description: Finds an available port by opening a temporary socket.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts server instances with given configuration, routes, and SSL settings.

methods.name: iter_procs
methods.description: Yields process objects from server instances.

methods.name: value_set
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is not None in a configuration dictionary.

methods.name: get_value_or_default
methods.description: Retrieves a value from config or returns a default if not set.

methods.name: set_computed_defaults
methods.description: Sets default paths for document root and WebSocket handlers if not specified.

methods.name: merge_json
methods.description: Merges two JSON objects, with override values taking precedence.

methods.name: get_ssl_environment
methods.description: Creates an SSL environment object based on configuration.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads and merges configuration JSON files, applying overrides and path validation.

methods.name: get_parser
methods.description: Creates an argument parser for command-line options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that loads configuration, sets up servers, and runs the event loop.
